rules.statement: The absence of a document evidencing an emphyteusis is not an insuperable objection, but the practical difficulty in proving it without a document makes it improper for this court to establish an emphyteusis.
rules.supporting_quote: the practical difficulty however in the way of a party seeking to establish an emphyteusis in the absence of a document is the difficulty of proving it, and so far as this particular case is concerned, in which the appellants do not rely upon a document as a starting point, it is in my opinion unnecessary to say more than that on the evidence adduced before the learned District Judge it would not be proper for this court to hold that an emphyteusis had been established.

meta.parties: Don Abraham, G. v. Samarakkody, C.C.D
